content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Alexandria

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Document your professional background and education now. Granite PM Academy's admissions team will verify your qualifications before course enrollment, ensuring you meet the credential standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Classes run on a schedule designed for working professionals in Alexandria's federal and research sectors. Attend all instructor-led sessions synchronously to satisfy PMI's formal-education requirement and build exam readiness.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, create an account on PMI's application portal and submit your PMP credential application. Pay PMI's examination fee through their secure system. Your Granite PM Academy instructor will guide you through the submission process and deadline to ensure timely processing.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and review sessions to reinforce core PMBOK® Guide concepts. You'll schedule your exam date through PMI's testing partner, then sit for the four-hour, computer-based assessment. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult topics before your test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. You must earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved PMI activities—training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or publishing—to renew. Plan your PDU strategy early in your cycle to ensure continuous credential status and career-long learning.
